concept_prompts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: an original industrial-tech logo symbol for Astering, a modern open-source personal project and AI workspace.
Primary request: a remarkably strong, minimal and artistically resolved asymmetric A-like monogram built from two bold oblique structural planes separated by one deliberate diagonal light gap. Convey forward force, precision and creative freedom. A clear broad silhouette and a large useful negative opening. Make the tension of the cut and the uneven balance beautiful, not just an ordinary typeset A. The abstraction may only suggest A; no need to draw a complete letter.
Style: flat vector-friendly master artwork, sharp controlled geometry, a few clean corners, generous negative space, premium editorial industrial identity. Restrained rather than futuristic decoration. Clear at 16 pixels.
Palette: single flat vivid signal yellow #FFFA00 symbol on a completely flat charcoal #191919 square background, referencing the color mood of Arknights Endfield official industrial visual language. No metallic gold.
Composition: exactly one centered isolated symbol, balanced 18 percent padding, square canvas. No lettering, no caption, no border.
Avoid: five petals, bauhinia flower, any flower or radial petal arrangement, rotating knot, fivefold symmetry, flags, political imagery, generic starburst, official Endfield logo, triangle cluster, military badge, tiny decorative cuts, hairlines, gradients, shadows, 3D, textures, glow, watermarks, presentation sheet, mockups. Deliver one clean graphic.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: an original industrial-tech logo symbol for Astering, an advanced open-source personal project and AI workspace.
Primary request: a striking abstract light-sail or displaced folded plane, formed from two broad asymmetric polygonal masses with a clean oblique channel between them. A taut composition with one long advancing edge and one compact counterweight. It should have the memorable simplicity of a leading open-source developer-tool brand, with carefully judged proportions and beautiful negative space. Suggest acceleration and a beam opening a path, without drawing a literal rocket or bird.
Style: completely flat vector-friendly artwork, restrained precision, strong off-axis directional tension, very few edges, excellent 16-pixel silhouette.
Palette: one flat vivid signal yellow #FFFA00 shape on a completely flat charcoal #191919 square background, using the industrial color mood seen in Arknights Endfield official visuals, without borrowing its actual logos.
Composition: single centered symbol, balanced 18 percent padding, square canvas, no words or letters.
Avoid: flowers, petals, fivefold or rotational symmetry, bauhinia, flags, political emblems, radial starburst, knot, official Endfield triangle cluster, military insignia, conventional shield, busy sci-fi interface, thin details, gradients, glow, shadows, texture, 3D, captions, watermark or mockup.

reference_scope: Arknights Endfield official color mood only; no game logo or character was used as a generation input.

production.method: Native polygon reconstruction of the chosen generated concept; two currentColor paths with simple straight segments. The diagonal gap is adjusted for small-size legibility. The SVG was not generated directly by imagegen.
production.avatar_method: Deterministic SVG composition from the exact shared paths, signal-yellow on charcoal.
